steps.text: RollerCoaster Tycoon 3's sound ran slow and the game lagged under Rosetta, whose x87 maths is slow, and on the Wine 10 engine it slowed to a crawl before the legal screen. This asks for a Wine 11 engine, which ships athei's x87sidecar, turns the sidecar on for this game with HB_X87SIDECAR=1 and sets DXVK, since D3DMetal and WineD3D draw a placed coaster as grey mush. Measured by udance4ever with the Epic copy on Wine 11 r30 with DXVK on an M1: sound right, 60 fps by the Metal HUD (highball-db#993, 2026-11-08). The Steam release also has a native Mac version, which Play prefers.
